data.description:
Die sic architekten gmbh ist ein innovatives Generalplanungsbüro mit über 40 Jahren Erfahrung. Wir stehen für Qualität, Kompetenz und Zuverlässigkeit – Werte, die sowohl unsere Architektur als auch unsere Unternehmenskultur prägen. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir nachhaltige, funktionale und ästhetische Gebäude – von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Umfeld, das Kreativität und persönliche Entwicklung fördert. Du möchtest die Gebäude von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt als:

Fachplaner TGA (m/w/d) - Versorgungstechnik & Gebäudeautomation

Aufgaben

  • Planung und Entwicklung technischer Konzepte für Heizung, Kälte, Lüftung, Sanitär und Gebäudeautomation.

  • Berechnung, Auslegung und Dimensionierung technischer Anlagen.

  • Fachplanung und Koordination der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung unter Anwendung der BIM-Methodik.

  • Erstellung von Ausschreibungsunterlagen und Mitwirkung bei der Vergabe von Bauleistungen.

  • Abstimmung und Koordination mit Architektur, Fachplanern und weiteren Projektbeteiligten.

  • Begleitung der Projekte von der Planung bis zur Realisierung

  • Qualitätssicherung auf der Baustelle sowie Sicherstellung der Kosten-, Termin- und Qualitätsziele.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Versorgungstechnik, Gebäudetechnik, Umweltingenieurwissenschaften, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Alternativ eine Qualifikation als Techniker oder Meister im Bereich Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Klima- oder Sanitärtechnik.

  • Berufserfahrung in der Planung und Umsetzung gebäudetechnischer Anlagen.

  • Fachkenntnisse in den Bereichen Heizung, Kälte, Lüftung und Sanitär sowie idealerweise Berührungspunkte mit der Gebäudeautomation.

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.

Benefits

  • Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis mit Perspektive und das Angebot einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

  • Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und volle Kostenübernahme für Weiterbildungen.

  • Überstundenausgleich sowie verkürzte Probezeit von vier Monaten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (Gleitzeit, 4-Tage-Woche) inklusive der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten an einem Tag pro Woche.

  • Dienstfahrzeug je nach Rolle und Verantwortungsbereich – auch zur privaten Nutzung.

  • Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder JobRad für umweltfreundliche Mobilität.

  • Teamgeist, geprägt durch hohe Motivation und gegenseitige Wertschätzung, ergänzt durch regelmäßige Veranstaltungen wie Grillnachmittage und Jahresauftaktfeiern.

  • Mitarbeit an Projekten im Großraum Köln, die die Stadt Köln und die nähere Umgebung maßgeblich prägen.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Für uns zählen neben deiner fachlichen Erfahrung vor allem deine Motivation und die Frage, ob wir zueinander passen.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung über das Portal mit frühestmöglichem Starttermin und Gehaltsvorstellung.

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven IT Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have a direct influence on our success.

As an IT Infrastructure Engineer, you lead the efforts of maintaining and improving our global identity and access management platform as a coherent set of highly available services following our cloud-focused strategy. It is your responsibility to identify improvement opportunities, drive identity projects, and build a unified, scalable environment.

Based in Germany and the US, our IT Infrastructure Services team designs, implements, and manages global cloud and on-premises infrastructure solutions to provide Flix with internal business services such as identity and access management, security and compliance configuration, communication tools, file sharing, 3rd-level support, and infrastructure consulting.

About the Role

  • Integrate new internal and external applications into our identity infrastructure (e.g., SSO) following best practices
  • Work on projects to improve internal role-based access control concepts
  • Consult other teams and guide them to success, leveraging our services especially regarding identity and access management
  • Drive innovation and improve our services together with the team
  • Automate recurring tasks
  • Design the future IT infrastructure of Flix

About You

  • At least 3 years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID or similar identity and access management platforms
  • Advanced knowledge of modern authentication protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and SAML)
  • At least 3 years of scripting experience (ideally with Python)
  • At least 1 year of experience with IaC solutions (preferably Terraform)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to streamline infrastructure automation, troubleshooting, and daily operations
  • Basic experience using APIs
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus
  • Experience working with IaaS solutions is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React) or web technologies is a plus
  • Experience with M365 products (such as Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams) is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

data.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Java/SpringBoot) to join our Shopping team in Berlin or working remotely from Germany. You will build the services behind our shopping rewards experience, online and in-store, which helps users get more value for their money.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap.
  • Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with:

  • 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side.
  • Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot.
  • Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems.
  • Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular.
  • Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts.
  • Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns.
  • Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for delivering clean code, unit/integration tests and maintainable documentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to support and mentor more junior members of a software development team.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️

*It varies from 1 to 3 interviews
*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.
#LI-AK1
#LI-Hybrid

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What We Do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

About the Account Executive role...

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Germany!

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!

What you'll do...

  • Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.

  • Achieving sales KPIs and targets - Working towards daily, weekly and monthly targets and finalize all sales in a timely manner.

  • Presentation and negotiation – Prepare accurate quotes and develop and present proposals to clients in a professional and confident manner. Negotiate contracts as required, maintaining a balance between optimal service and value for the client and SiteMinder's profit margins.

  • CRM maintenance – Maintain accurate records of your business development activities on SiteMinder's CRM system.

  • Client feedback – Provide client feedback on products to the Product Team so that products can be reviewed in line with the feedback.

  • Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.

What you have...

  • Experience in Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) sales

  • Fluent in German (min. C2)

  • Professional proficiency in English

  • A confident phone presence, fearlessness in leading meetings with prospects, and great listening skills

  • Strong communication skills professionally with customers, in writing and over the phone

  • Self-motivation and resilience to show up each day and give your best

  • Growth mindset - openness to feedback and coaching

  • Please send us your CV in English!

Our Perks & Benefits…

  • Remote setup

  • Equity packages for you to share in SiteMinder's growth and successes

  • Investment in your personal growth

  • Uncapped commission that rewards overachievement

  • Excellence-driven, collaborative culture

  • Well-being initiatives

  • Referral bonus for bringing in new talent

  • Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy

  • Paid birthday, study and volunteering days off every year

  • Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved

Does this job sound like you? If yes, we'd love for you to be part of our team! Please send a copy of your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

 

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

data.description:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

 

Your tasks:

  • Evolve, expand and maintain our component libraries on all our platforms (iOS, Android and Web): Angular, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI fed by a shared design system.

  • Partner closely with our UI/UX designers on component APIs, naming, states, and variants, keeping our code in sync with our Figma library - closing the gap between what is designed and what ships.

  • Define the system's architecture: theming and brand layering, versioning, releases, and a contribution model that invites our domain teams in rather than shutting them out.

  • Maintain living documentation (e.g. Storybook) and drive adoption through pairing, reviews, and migration paths.

  • Make accessibility and responsive behavior built-in properties of our components, not an afterthought.

  • Adopt agentic coding practices and use AI coding agents to accelerate development, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and outcomes.

What you offer us:

  • Several years as a frontend or mobile engineer, including hands-on ownership of a design system or shared component library used by multiple teams.

  • TypeScript and Angular skills or comparable depth in another modern framework / library and a clear willingness to go all in on Angular plus a sharp instinct for component API design.

  • Hands-on native UI development with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose or Swift/SwiftUI. You will author native components yourself. Strong expertise in one platform, combined with an interest in developing a working knowledge of the other, is perfectly fine.

  • Experience with design tokens and theming multi-brand environments: building one system that carries several brands without forking.

  • A strong grasp of responsive and adaptive design and of accessibility standards, and the habit of verifying both in practice.

data.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

What we're building

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. We build AI software that helps production engineers and operators turn machine data into answers: why a line is slowing down, what's causing scrap, and what to fix next. We're early and in stealth. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding core team.

Your role & responsibility

You're the person who makes our product work in the real world. You go into a plant, figure out what's actually broken, connect the data, and stay until operators use the product every day without being asked. You'll work with everyone from the machine operator to the plant manager, and with IT and OT. You own each customer from the first conversation through rollout and expansion. Berlin or home-based in Germany, with regular time in Berlin with the team. You'll spend about 20% of your time at customer sites.

What you'll do

  • Own deployments end to end: use-case definition, data onboarding, validation, rollout, training, and adoption

  • Turn messy production problems into clear data, analytics, and solution requirements

  • Onboard and validate machine, process, quality, and maintenance data from industrial systems

  • Spot data problems that only make sense if you understand the machine behind them

  • Build and validate KPIs, features, anomaly signals, calibration methods, and analytical workflows in Python and SQL, using statistics and time-series analysis

  • Run the project with the customer and our commercial lead: plans, workshops, validation sessions, and success criteria

  • Find the next machine, line, data source, or use case, and expand with it

  • Bring what you learn in the field back to the product, so each deployment makes the platform better

  • Help write the playbook for how we deliver, as the customer engineering team grows

You might be a fit if you

  • Have worked hands-on with industrial machines and production processes, in manufacturing, automation, maintenance, quality, industrial engineering, or industrial data

  • Know your way around PLCs, SCADA, MES, historians, production databases, quality systems, or OPC UA

  • Use Python and SQL to answer questions, not just to write code

  • Have worked with time-series data, KPIs, anomaly detection, or root-cause analysis

  • Communicate as well on the shop floor as in the plant manager's office

  • Like solving hard problems in automation and process engineering

  • Take ownership, work independently, and are comfortable when things are ambiguous

  • Are happy to travel to customer sites and have a driver's license

  • Speak fluent German and English

A degree is optional. A Meister, Techniker, vocational training, or real-world experience counts just as much. We care about what you can do.

We're open to experienced people who can lead deployments on their own, and to exceptional earlier-career people with strong industrial experience who learn fast.

This is not a desk job. It's hands-on and customer-facing, and you'll spend a lot of your time where the machines are.

Why now

You'll be one of the first people in the company. You'll work directly with the founders and shape how we deliver to customers from day one. What you build here becomes the way we work. We'll tell you more about the company, the founders, and our backers in the first conversation.

data.description:
Who We Are

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Our core business model revolves around producing precisely what our customers desire, precisely when they desire it. As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as of January 2027, as Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. 

What Will Your Role Be

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) in our Merchant Experience team, you’ll help build and evolve the digital products our partners and merchants interact with every day. You’ll work across the entire merchant journey — from the Partner Area, where designers manage their designs and shops, to the sign-up and publishing experience that turns an idea into a live SpreadShop, and the Merchant Area, where SpreadConnect merchants manage integrations with Shopify, TikTok, and other platforms. As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d), you’ll take ownership beyond individual UI components or API endpoints. You’ll design and implement features end-to-end, collaborate closely with product and design, and ensure that the experiences you build are reliable, performant, and easy to evolve. Your work directly impacts how merchants use and grow with our platform. You’ll build products that make their day-to-day work easier and help drive our business forward.

What You´ll Do 

  • Build and evolve merchant-facing product surfaces — sign-up and shop creation flows, shop management, design and product administration, sales statistics

  • Build the new publishing journey for shops — from sign-up to a live SpreadShop — and take drop-off out of every step

  • Own small to medium features end to end: design the UI, build theKotlin/Spring endpoints behind it, model the data, and ship both together

  • Extend our backend services where your features need it — new REST endpointsin the shop and partner services, data model changes with a proper migration, and integrations with external platforms such as Shopify or TikTok on the SpreadConnect side

  • Design and consume our REST and GraphQL APIs, and push back when a responseshape makes the frontend's life harder than it needs to be

  • Contribute to our cross-team frontend architecture work — shared components,hooks and API clients, and how we render, test and ship our apps

  • Keep merchant tooling fast — data-heavy tables, sales statistics and editorsare where perceived performance is won or lost

  • Take on larger topics — an epic, a new integration, a new merchant surface —and break them down into something the team can execute: slices, dependencies, open questions, and a first piece worth shipping

  • Work in an agile cross-functional team with a product owner, designers and backend engineers, and connect what you build to merchant activation and conversion

What You´ll Bring

  • Solid proficiency in TypeScript and React — component design, hooks, statemanagement, and the performance patterns that keep a growing app fast

  • Around three or more years of professional experience building web products, with a track record of features you carried from first ticket to production

  • Real CSS craft and experience working inside a design system or shared component library, not just against one

  • Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with structured, data-heavy responses — product catalogs, variants and attributes bring more complexity than they first appear to

  • Working experience in a JVM backend — Kotlin or Java with Spring — and the ability to build a REST endpoint, model the data behind it and write the migration, not just read the code

  • A solid grasp of relational databases and SQL, and of what happens to a query when the table stops being small

  • Self-direction: you take an under-specified problem, find out what is actually needed, break it into deliverable pieces and drive them to donewithout waiting to be handed tickets

  • Testing as a habit rather than an afterthought, and a working relationship with code review

  • A keen eye for UI detail — you care about how something feels, not only whether it works

  • A product mindset: you ask who benefits from a change before you ask how to build it

  • Good communication skills in English

Why Should You Join Us

 

  • Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business.

  • Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so.

  • We Win as a Team: Work alongside ambitious, motivated colleagues who challenge and support each other to achieve exceptional results. Through honest feedback, high standards, and shared ambition, we bring out the best in one another.

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work closely with experienced founders and business leaders, gaining first-hand insights into growing a successful international company.

  • Transparency and Involvement: Stay connected to our vision through regular General Assemblies, learn about our processes in our production sites in the Czech Republic and join workshops and cross function initiatives to lead positive change.

  • The Extras That Matter: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, attractive employee discounts on our products and partner brands, modern office spaces designed for collaboration, and regular company events where we celebrate our successes together.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We value diversity at Spread Group. We are proud of and continue to encourage the increasing diversity of our company culture and community. Your skills, talents, and experience are our focus no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital or disability status.

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer

  • You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet.

  • You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones.

  • You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production.

  • You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on.

  • You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against.

    You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary.

  • You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships.

You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it.

How we design:

  • We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on.

  • We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships.

What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

Here's how we picture you as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • You have 8+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years operating at Senior, Principal, or Staff altitude.

  • You have designed for AI and non-determinism before, and can talk concretely about how you've communicated agent behaviour, handled errors, and kept users in control, not just in the abstract.

  • You have owned or significantly contributed to a design system, at the level of patterns and principles rather than individual components.

  • You are block-shaped: equally strong across UX process, UI craft, product thinking, research, storytelling, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • You have taken features from 0 to 1 through an ambiguous problem statement to shipped code, and you're comfortable feeling like a PM or frontend developer on the days that calls for it.

  • You have high agency and spot gaps without being asked to look for them, including outside your own product area.

  • You hold a position under pressure but change it when new information warrants, rather than becoming precious about your own decisions.

  • You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable operating in an international environment; German is a plus but not required.

  • You bring a consumer-grade craft background with exceptional design; healthtech experience is a plus but not required.

  • If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you

About Recare

With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.


What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

  • Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories.

  • Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany).

  • Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

  • Together: team meetups and company-wide events.

Location

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.

Senior Backend Engineer - Java/Kotlin (x/f/m)

Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the IAM (Identity and Access Management) team in Platform Services Tech.

Your mission will be to secure and scale the authentication capabilities that millions of Doctolib users rely on every day. You will drive the most impactful phases of a critical, multi-year migration to a self-hosted, Keycloak-based identity provider — a project at the intersection of platform engineering, security, and cross-team impact. Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead the next phases of the multi-year authentication migration to a self-hosted, Keycloak-based identity provider — completing token-based sign-in for Doctolib Pro apps and making the identity provider the single source of truth for user data

  • Own the reliability of high-traffic authentication systems end-to-end: monitoring, alerting, SLOs, incident resolution, post-mortems, and safe rollout practices (feature flags, canary releases, zero-downtime migrations)

  • Drive cross-team delivery independently: produce design documents and decision memos, build alignment across dependent teams, and make trade-offs explicit

  • Collaborate closely with the Product Security team on security-sensitive architecture decisions and changes

  • Contribute to frontend development in React and TypeScript on the custom interfaces tied to the IAM platform

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate your own work and help establish repeatable AI-augmented workflows across the team

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 7–10+ years of backend engineering experience with hands-on, daily Java or Kotlin development and a solid understanding of JVM internals (garbage collection, memory management, multi-threading, and profiling)

  • Have proven experience building and operating high-traffic production systems at scale — load testing, capacity planning, horizontal scaling, caching, and performance bottleneck identification

  • Own reliability end-to-end: you define monitoring, alerting, and SLOs, lead incident resolution, write post-mortems, and have shipped changes safely via feature flags, canary releases, and zero-downtime migrations on live systems

  • Have led complex, multi-week cross-team delivery independently — producing design docs, driving alignment across dependent teams, and making trade-offs explicit without waiting for consensus

  • Use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow, critically validate their outputs, and are excited to help establish shared AI practices for your team

  • Are fluent in English (written and spoken)

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have prior experience with identity providers (e.g. Keycloak), OAuth2, and/or OIDC

  • Have hands-on experience with security practices for exposed, high-traffic endpoints

  • Have contributed to frontend codebases in React and TypeScript

  • Have exposure to Kafka/CDC

  • Have exposure to mobile authentication

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

Knuspr ist Teil der Rohlik Gruppe – und wir verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen Lebensmittel einkaufen. Unser Herz schlägt für frische, hochwertige Produkte und eine blitzschnelle Lieferung direkt an die Haustür. In dieser Rolle bewegst du täglich unsere Waren, versorgst die Packstrecken und stellst sicher, dass die LKW pünktlich und sicher be- und entladen werden.   • Mitten im Geschehen: Du bist das Rückgrat unseres Warenlagers und sorgst direkt dafür, dass unsere Kommissionierung ohne Unterbrechung arbeiten kann.

  • Moderne Logistik: Du arbeitest in einem hochdynamischen E-Food-Umfeld mit modernem Warenwirtschaftssystem und professionellen Flurförderzeugen.

  • Transparente Verdienstmöglichkeiten: Ein verlässliches Fixgehalt ab 2.600 € brutto plus volle Bezahlung jeder geleisteten Überstunde.

  • Starkes Benefit-Paket: Tägliche Zuschüsse für Verpflegung und Anfahrt sowie attraktive Mitarbeiter-Mischrabatte bei Knuspr und externen Partnern.

Was du bei uns tust

  • Warentransport & Einlagerung: Innerbetriebliche Verräumung und Umlagerung von Lebensmitteln und Materialien im und aus dem Hochregallager mittels Flurförderzeugen.

  • Versorgung der Produktion: Pünktliche Belieferung der Kommissionierungsstrecke mit den benötigten Produkten.

  • Verladetätigkeiten: Fachgerechtes und sicheres Be- und Entladen von LKW.

  • Systemführung: Erfassung und Buchung der Warenbewegungen im internen Warenwirtschaftssystem.

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation & Fahrpraxis: Ein gültiger Staplerschein sowie nachweisbare, praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit dem Schubmaststapler.

  • Hochregalerfahrung: Erste praktische Erfahrung bei der Ein- und Auslagerung in Hochregalsystemen.

  • Fair Reward: Attraktives monatliches Fixgehalt ab 2.600 € brutto sowie volle Bezahlung geleisteter Überstunden.

  • Tägliche Zuschüsse: Zusätzlich 9,00 € Essenszulage sowie 5,00 € Fahrtkostenzuschlag pro Arbeitstag.

data.description:
Your role

As our CMO Partner Manager (all genders), you will serve as the strategic interface between our internal teams (R&D, Quality, Operations) and external manufacturing partners. You will own your product categories end-to-end - securing product availability, driving cost efficiency, and leveraging external manufacturing intelligence to spark innovation within our supply chain.

  • Drive Security of Supply: Guarantee product availability and eliminate stockouts through proactive risk management, robust capacity planning, and flawless data tracking (ETAs).

  • Manage & Scale Partner Networks: Continuously screen the market for new manufacturing capabilities, onboard strategic CMO partners, and manage day-to-day partner operations.

  • Optimize TCO & Commercials: Build deep market insight into raw material and manufacturing costs to negotiate optimal pricing, terms, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

  • Drive Launch Execution: Direct New Product Introductions (NPI) from concept to market launch, ensuring cross-functional and partner alignment to meet project timelines.

  • Champion Quality & Efficiency: Hold partners accountable to strict delivery reliability (OTIF) and swift quality resolution (CAPA), while bringing external best practices back to internal operations.

Your profile

  • Background & Experience: 5+ years in strategic procurement, category management, or contract manufacturing (CMO) - ideally in dietary supplements, FMCG, food, or pharma. Experience in complex batch manufacturing is a strong plus.

  • Strategic & Commercial Acumen: You understand how procurement drives value beyond unit price - leveraging TCO models, raw material cost structures, and smart negotiations to optimize margins.

  • Project & Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives (e.g., NPIs). You excel at bridging internal teams (R&D, Quality, Supply Chain, Accounting, Legal) with external manufacturing partners to keep projects moving.

  • Data & Analytical Mindset: Highly data-driven and comfortable with large datasets. You translate operational metrics and spend data into clear priorities, actionable insights, and negotiation leverage.

  • Process & System Orientation: You think in scalable systems—capable of refining workflows (P2P, SOPs, partner onboarding) and maintaining data integrity without overengineering processes.

  • Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with modern ERP systems (e.g., Odoo or similar MRP), project platforms (e.g., monday.com), and BI tools (e.g., Tableau or Salesforce).

  • Language Skills: Fluent in English (C1); German or Polish proficiency is a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

Standort: Deutschland (flexibel / hybrid)
Berichtet an: Executive Leadership Team
Verantwortungsbereich: Gesamtverantwortung für kommerzielles Wachstum, Organisationsentwicklung und Geschäftsergebnis in Deutschland in den Märkten Utility-Scale BESS sowie Community, Commercial & Industrial (CCI).

Über iwell
iwell ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter von intelligentem Energiemanagement und Batteriespeicherlösungen (Battery Energy Storage Solutions, BESS). Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, Energiekosten zu senken, den Energieverbrauch zu optimieren, ihre Resilienz zu erhöhen und die Energiewende zu beschleunigen. iwell hat eine starke Erfolgsbilanz in ganz Europa und eine etablierte Präsenz in Deutschland. Darauf aufbauend startet iwell in die nächste Wachstumsphase in einem der dynamischsten und strategisch wichtigsten Energiespeichermärkte des Kontinents.

Für diese Ambition sucht iwell eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Country Director / Managing Director Germany (m/w/d). Sie führen das deutsche Geschäft und treiben die weitere Expansion in zentralen Wachstumssegmenten voran.

Sie berichten direkt an das Executive Leadership Team und tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für das deutsche Geschäft. Dabei vereinen Sie kommerzielle Führung, strategische Ausrichtung, Organisationsentwicklung und operative Steuerung. Sie treiben das Vertriebswachstum selbst voran. Sie stärken die Marktposition von iwell, skalieren die lokalen Aktivitäten und erreichen ambitionierte Wachstumsziele, stets in enger Abstimmung mit der übergeordneten Gruppenstrategie.


Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit: Sie führen einen der wichtigsten Märkte in der europäischen Wachstumsstrategie von iwell und tragen direkt zur Transformation des deutschen Energiesektors bei.

Die Chance
Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Wachstum in zwei strategischen Geschäftsbereichen:
Utility-Scale BESS
Ausbau der Präsenz von iwell bei großen Batteriespeicherprojekten. Dazu gehört der Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Projektentwicklern, EPC-Unternehmen, Investoren, Energieversorgern, unabhängigen Stromerzeugern (IPPs), Übertragungs- und Verteilnetzbetreibern sowie weiteren zentralen Stakeholdern im gesamten Energie-Ökosystem.
Community, Commercial & Industrial (CCI)
Beschleunigung des Wachstums bei dezentralen Energiespeicheranwendungen. Der Fokus liegt auf Branchen wie Verkehrs- und Logistikinfrastruktur, Mobilität und Flottenelektrifizierung, Gewerbeimmobilien, Industrieanlagen, Häfen und Rechenzentren. Hinzu kommen weitere energieintensive Standorte, die mehr Resilienz, Optimierung und Nachhaltigkeit in ihrer Energieversorgung anstreben.
Ihre Aufgabe ist es, die bestehende Marktdynamik in nachhaltiges kommerzielles Wachstum umzusetzen und eine High-Performance-Kultur zu fördern. Dabei stellen Sie sicher, dass das deutsche Geschäft eng an den strategischen Zielen der Gruppe ausgerichtet bleibt.

Ihre Aufgaben
Strategische Führung

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der langfristigen Geschäftsstrategie für Deutschland im Einklang mit den Zielen der Gruppe und den europäischen Wachstumsambitionen.

  • Definition und Umsetzung von Wachstumsplänen für die Geschäftsbereiche Utility-Scale BESS und CCI.

  • Identifikation neuer Marktchancen, Partnerschaften, Vertriebswege und Umsatzquellen im deutschen Energie-Ökosystem.

  • Festlegung von Jahresplänen, Budgets und Wachstumszielen für das deutsche Geschäft.

  • Direkter Beitrag zu übergreifenden europäischen Wachstumsinitiativen und zur Unternehmensstrategie.

Kommerzielles Wachstum & Marktentwicklung

  • Vorantreiben der weiteren Expansion des deutschen Geschäfts von iwell in den Märkten für Großbatteriespeicher (Utility-Scale) und dezentrale Batteriespeicher.

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen auf Senior-Ebene zu Projektentwicklern, EPCs, Energieversorgern, Aggregatoren, Infrastruktureigentümern, Investoren, strategischen Partnern sowie großen gewerblichen und industriellen Energieverbrauchern.

  • Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung kommerzieller Strategien, die nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum und steigende Marktanteile sichern.

  • Identifikation und Gewinnung strategischer Partnerschaften, die die Wettbewerbsposition von iwell stärken und das Wachstum beschleunigen.

  • Repräsentation von iwell als zentrales Gesicht des Unternehmens in der sich rasant wandelnden Landschaft der deutschen Energiewende.

Geschäftsführung & Operations

  • Gesamtverantwortung für Performance und Wachstum des deutschen Geschäfts.

  • Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz in Vertrieb, Projektabwicklung, Customer Success, Service und Support.

  • Etablierung wirksamer Strukturen für Governance, Performance-Management und Reporting.

  • Steuerung von Budgetierung, Forecasting, Ressourcenplanung und Profitabilitätszielen.

  • Regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Executive Leadership Team zur Geschäftsentwicklung und zu Markteinblicken.

Teamführung

  • Aufbau, Führung und Weiterentwicklung einer leistungsstarken deutschen Organisation, die ambitionierte Wachstumspläne tragen kann.

  • Rekrutierung, Mentoring und Bindung herausragender Talente in kommerziellen, operativen und kundennahen Funktionen.

  • Förderung einer Kultur von Verantwortung, Zusammenarbeit, Kundenorientierung und Exzellenz.

  • Sichtbare und inspirierende Führung mit unternehmerischer und hands-on Arbeitsweise.

Markt- & Stakeholder-Engagement

  • Vertretung von iwell auf Branchenkonferenzen, bei Kundenterminen, in Regierungsforen und in Branchenverbänden.

  • Aufbau von Beziehungen zu zentralen Stakeholdern im gesamten Ökosystem der deutschen Energiewende.

  • Fundiertes und aktuelles Verständnis von Marktentwicklungen, Regulierung, Trends im Energiespeicherbereich, Flexibilitätsmärkten und neuen Chancen.

Ihr Profil
Wir suchen eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, etwa als Country Leader, Managing Director, General Manager oder Senior Commercial Executive. Sie verbinden strategische Weitsicht mit ausgeprägtem kommerziellem Gespür und können Unternehmen im deutschen Energiewendesektor skalieren.

Erfahrung & Qualifikationen

  • Umfangreiche Führungserfahrung in den Bereichen Batteriespeicher, erneuerbare Energien, dezentrale Energie, Energieinfrastruktur, Ladeinfrastruktur für E-Mobilität, Flexibilitätsdienstleistungen, Smart Energy, Energiesysteme oder in angrenzenden Branchen.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in relevanten Kundensegmenten wie Transport, Logistik, Flottenelektrifizierung, Gewerbeimmobilien sowie Co-Location von erneuerbaren Energien und BESS.

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge in der Führung einer Ländergesellschaft, eines Geschäftsbereichs, einer regionalen Organisation oder einer wachstumsstarken kommerziellen Einheit.

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wachstumsstrategien.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis des deutschen Energiemarkts, des regulatorischen Umfelds und der kommerziellen Dynamik.

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb komplexer technischer Lösungen und infrastrukturbasierter Energieprodukte.

  • Starkes Netzwerk unter Projektentwicklern, Energieversorgern, EPCs, Investoren, Aggregatoren, gewerblichen und industriellen Kunden sowie weiteren Akteuren der Energiewende.

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke Teams aufzubauen und zu führen.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Geschäftsergebnissen, Budgets, Forecasts und kommerziellen Zielen.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Persönliche Eigenschaften

  • Strategisch denkende und kommerziell versierte Führungskraft.

  • Unternehmerisch, wachstumsorientiert und hands-on.

  • Hohe Glaubwürdigkeit und die Fähigkeit, Senior Stakeholder intern wie extern zu überzeugen.

  • Ergebnisorientiert, mit ausgeprägten analytischen Fähigkeiten und Entscheidungsstärke.

  • Leidenschaft für die Energiewende und technologiegetriebene Innovation.

Warum iwell?

  • Führung eines der strategisch wichtigsten europäischen Märkte von iwell.

  • Aufbau auf einer etablierten Plattform und starker Marktdynamik, mit der Chance, die nächste Wachstumsphase aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Eine führende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung der deutschen Energiewende durch innovative Batteriespeicherlösungen.

  • Einfluss auf die Strategie auf deutscher und europäischer Ebene, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Executive Leadership Team.

  • Langfristige Wertschöpfung durch das Wachstum einer äußerst ambitionierten und unternehmerischen Organisation.

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket auf Executive-Niveau mit wettbewerbsfähigem Grundgehalt, leistungsabhängigem Bonus und Beteiligung an der langfristigen Wertsteigerung.

Interesse geweckt?
Mehr über iwell, was wir tun, warum wir es tun, und einen Überblick über unsere Partner finden Sie unter https://iwell.eu/.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess
Bewerbung. Unser People & Culture Team und die einstellende Führungskraft prüfen Ihre Bewerbung und melden sich innerhalb von 2 Wochen bei Ihnen.
Telefonisches Erstgespräch. Sind Sie ein echter iweller-in-the-making? Wir laden Sie zu einem Kennenlerngespräch ein.
Sind Sie die richtige Person? Es folgen zwei oder mehr Interviews. Für einige Positionen bitten wir Sie zusätzlich, eine Fallstudie zu bearbeiten.

WOULD YOU LIKE TO BE PART OF A FAST - GROWING ORGANISATION? 

JOIN US AS AREA COMMERCIAL DIRECTOR!

ABOUT ODYSSEY 

We're The Odyssey Hotel Group, Europe’s most ambitious hotel operator and the team behind many famous global hospitality names. We partner with Marriott, IHG, and Accor to develop exceptional properties across various brands, from Holiday Express to Marriott's Autograph collection. Powered by over 800 employees and supported by Activum SG as our major shareholder, our purpose is to shape hospitality together!

ABOUT POSITION

The Portfolio Commercial Director is responsible for the overall commercial performance of a blended portfolio of full service hotels, strongly MICE driven hotels in key markets in Germany.

This role holds end-to-end accountability for commercial strategy and execution, covering Sales, Revenue Management, Distribution, and Marketing, with a strong focus on sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, and profitability, while ensuring alignment with owner expectations and long-term asset value creation.

As a senior commercial leader, the role acts as a trusted advisor to hotel owners and asset managers, delivering transparent, data-driven insights and ensuring that all commercial strategies support both short-term performance and long-term financial returns.

The position operates within a matrix organisation, partnering closely with Operations, Finance, and commercial discipline leaders to drive integrated commercial strategies across the portfolio.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and execute hotel-level commercial strategies aligned with overall business goals.

• Lead forecasting and budgeting processes to ensure accurate financial planning and performance tracking.

• Drive commercial initiatives at both the hotel and country levels to maximize total hotel revenue opportunities.

• Executive report on results and present business analytics to internal and external stakeholders.

• Act as primary commercial liaison with Hotel Operations, ensuring alignment between commercial and operational priorities.

• Oversee account management and achieving sales targets, maintaining strong customer and partner relationships.

• Manage pricing and inventory strategy, ensuring optimal yield and market competitiveness.

• Develop, manage, and recruit commercial team members, in close cooperation with the relevant commercial disciplinary leader, to build strong regional capabilities and performance.

• Lead structured owner communication, including monthly and quarterly reviews, clearly articulating performance drivers, risks, and opportunities

HOW YOU WILL DO IT

• Building strong and trusted relationships with hotel owners, asset managers, Hotel Managers, and internal stakeholders.

• Applying sound commercial judgement and data-driven decision-making to drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability.

• Translating complex commercial performance data into clear business insights and actionable strategies.

• Aligning Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, and Operations around common business objectives.

• Proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and market trends and adapting commercial strategies accordingly.

• Providing clear direction, coaching, and support to commercial teams, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

• Influencing stakeholders at all levels through effective communication, collaboration, and executive presence.

• Maintaining a strong focus on owner satisfaction, long-term asset value creation, and sustainable business growth.

• Ensuring commercial excellence through structured planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and continuous improvement.

• Balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver measurable business results.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 5-8+ years of experience in hotel commercial leadership, across Sales, Revenue Management, or Commercial Operations

  • Proven experience in multi-property / regional roles

  • Strong track record in driving revenue growth, market share, and profitability

  • Deep expertise in:

    • Revenue Management (pricing, forecasting, distribution)

    • Commercial strategy and demand generation

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with hotel owners, asset managers, or investors

  • Strong analytical capability with ability to translate data into strategic insights

  • Experience presenting budgets, forecasts, and performance to senior stakeholders

  • Proven leadership in building and managing high-performing teams

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills

  • Ability to operate effectively in a matrix organisation

  • Results-driven mindset with focus on asset value and long-term performance

  • Full professional fluency in English and German (written and spoken)

What do we offer

  • A competitive salary with bonus plan

  • Holiday & Christmas bonus after 6 months

  • laptop, phone and appropriate travel compensation depending of what fits your needs

  • A diverse, multicultural, and dynamic work environment

  • Respective of your work scope, discounted stays at large branded hotels worldwide such as Marriott, IHG and all Odyssey properties

  • 30 vacation days from day one for a healthy work-life balance

  • Access to a health card to reimburse health related invoices - Health insurance card with €300 annual budget

  • Access to “Corporate Benefits” discounts

  • Ongoing training, personal growth opportunities, and priority access to internal vacancies.

  • €500 net referral bonus for new hires

Unsere Kunden setzen auf uns, weil wir die komplexen regulatorischen und operativen Anforderungen des Gesundheitsmarktes kennen und passgenaue Lösungen dafür liefern.

  • Greenfield: Du baust unseren AI-Coding-Stack von Grund auf – kein Legacy-Setup, keine Altlasten

Dafür brauchen wir Dich

  • Testautomatisierung & Dokumentation: Du schließt unsere größten technischen Lücken: automatisierte Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests sowie agententaugliche technische Dokumentation im Repository.
  • Quality Gates: Du etablierst automatisierte Code-Reviews als festen Bestandteil unserer CI/CD-Pipeline und baust eine synthetische Test-Daten-Factory auf, die den gesamten Workflow aus dem DSGVO-Scope hält.
  • Aktive Entwicklung: Du entwickelst mit – rund die Hälfte Deiner Zeit baust Du reale Features über genau die Pipeline, die Du aufsetzt. Der Mix ist wellenförmig: Phasen intensiver Stack-Arbeit wechseln mit Phasen aktiver Entwicklung.
  • Governance: Du definierst die verbindlichen KI-Vorgaben für unsere externen Entwicklungsdienstleister und verantwortest das interne Quality Gate. Dabei führst Du kein Team – gefragt ist fachliche Autorität, keine disziplinarische.
  • Wissenstransfer: Du arbeitest einen internen Kollegen ein, der die Rolle gemeinsam mit Dir trägt und den Stack langfristig mitverantwortet.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast rund 7-10 Jahre professionelle Softwareentwicklung auf Senior- oder Lead-Niveau hinter Dir, mit Architekturverantwortung. Java und Spring Boot im Backend, idealerweise Angular im Frontend.
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C1) und fließend Englisch und hast einen Wohnsitz in Deutschland.

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit agentischen Coding-Werkzeugen wie Claude Code, Cursor oder Codex und orchestrierst mehrere Agenten parallel. Jahreszahlen erwarten wir hier ausdrücklich nicht – diese Arbeitsweise gibt es erst seit Ende 2025.
  • Du pflegst eigene Kontext-Dateien, Skills und System-Prompts und kannst sie uns zeigen. Du hast eine belastbare Antwort darauf, wie Du agentengenerierten Code verifizierst.
  • Du kannst begründen, warum Du welches Werkzeug einsetzt – statt dem jeweils neuesten Trend zu folgen.
  • Du verstehst Business, nicht nur Technik, und kannst gegenüber externen Dienstleistern Standards setzen und durchsetzen.
  • Wünschenswerte Kenntnisse: Idealerweise hast Du bereits eine eigene agentische Entwicklungs-Pipeline aufgebaut – inklusive Review und Testing, beruflich oder privat. Erfahrung in regulierten Umfeldern sowie in der Steuerung externer Entwicklungsdienstleister ist von Vorteil.

data.description:
Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien.

Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front.

Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur.

Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe.

Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre.

Ce que tu vas faire chez nous

  • Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production.

  • Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler.

  • PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité.

  • Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes.

  • Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs.

  • Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi.

Ce qui t'attend techniquement

  • Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo

  • Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry

  • Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour

Profil recherché

  • 6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs.

  • Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps.

  • Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run.

  • Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. Quand on manipule des documents légaux et des données dont nos clients dépendent au quotidien, la question « que se passe-t-il si cet appel échoue au milieu ? » compte plus que la maîtrise d'un framework.

  • Tu sais prendre des décisions avec une information incomplète et les assumer. On cherche quelqu'un qui tranche, pas quelqu'un qui organise une quatrième réunion.

  • Tu sais avancer dans l'imparfait. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique.

  • Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite.

  • Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs.

Processus de recrutement

  • Echange RH

  • Entretien technique avec un développeur de l'équipe

  • Entretien technique (algorithme et design technique) avec le CTO

  • Entretien de fit avec deux des fondateurs

  • Prise de référence et offre

Conditions

  • Salaire: 50-65 k€ selon expérience

  • Télétravail: full remote (et des bureaux à Paris si tu en as envie)

At remberg, you’ll help to keep the world running.

Everything that gets produced relies on a maintenance team behind the scenes that keeps the machines, equipment and infrastructure running. We are helping these teams by simplifying their work with modern, agentic maintenance software. At remberg, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more.

Supported by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software.

WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS

Als Forward Deployed Engineer sorgst du dafür, dass remberg bei unseren Kunden zum Herzstück der Instandhaltung wird. Du arbeitest hands-on zwischen Prospects, Kunden, Product und Engineering. Du verbindest remberg mit SAP und anderen ERP-Systemen, bringst Sensor- und Maschinendaten auf die Plattform und gibst der remberg KI den Kontext, den sie braucht, um in der Industrie echten Mehrwert zu liefern. Du baust, was Kund:innen brauchen, bringst es schnell live und lässt deine Learnings direkt ins Produkt einfließen.

Als erster FDE bei remberg gestaltest du die Rolle von Grund auf und baust die ersten Playbooks. Du berichtest direkt an Julian Borg, unseren Co-Founder und CPO, und arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Go-to-Market sowie Product und Engineering zusammen.

Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Office in München und bist im Schnitt ein paar Tage im Monat bei Kunden vor Ort.

THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE

SAP/ERP-Integration: Du entwickelst Integrationen zwischen remberg und SAP (z. B. SAP PM/MM, S/4HANA, ECC) oder anderen ERP-Systemen. Dabei begleitest du sie vom technischen Scoping über das Data Mapping bis zum stabilen Betrieb nach dem Go-live.
